title: SRCNN on KV260: experiment evolution
subtitle: Condensed from 231 registered experiments (results.csv). Only turning points are drawn; every ID links to experiments/<ID>_*/. Numbers are ms/frame; the evidence level is stated on each node.

metric.note: ms/frame = cycles x clock period. HLS = HLS estimated cycles x target clock; RTL x routed = C/RTL co-simulation cycles x an independently closed post-route clock. No value is a board measurement.

groups.stream: Phase 1b: streaming architecture and parameter sweep
groups.branches: Phase 2: architecture branches (packing, Winograd, scatter, tiling, DDR, combination)
groups.physical: Phase 3: physical verification and route calibration
groups.winograd: Phase 3: Winograd T8 with private parameters
groups.t4: Phase 4: ROM, clock and T4 workstream

experiments.title: Original float baseline
experiments.idea: Measure the untouched golden source before changing anything
experiments.problem: BRAM18K 11,064 needed, device has 288: full 23.8 MiB feature maps cannot stay on chip

experiments.title: Per-layer range and bit-width scan
experiments.idea: Scan 16/12/10/8-bit fixed point on all 13 Set14 images (numpy fake-quant)

experiments.title: ap_fixed reference, 10-bit
experiments.idea: Real ap_fixed loading, layer-boundary rounding and saturation; becomes the bit-exact reference

experiments.title: Conv2-only 8-bit weights
experiments.idea: Mixed precision point: only Conv2 weights and bias to signed 8-bit

experiments.title: Directives only: pipeline inner loop
experiments.idea: Keep the structure, add pipelining directives
experiments.problem: Configuration keys silently ignored by the tool; result identical to E000

experiments.title: Directives (valid retry)
experiments.idea: Generate directives from the schema, reject unknown keys
experiments.problem: BRAM18K 11,114: directives alone cannot fix whole-image storage

experiments.title: 10-bit streaming network, T=32
experiments.idea: Line buffers and stream connections remove the full intermediate feature maps
experiments.problem: LUT 136,868: narrow multiplications fell into LUTs, only 9 DSP used

experiments.title: Force products onto DSP
experiments.idea: One change: bind the 251 products per cycle to DSP48
experiments.problem: 251 DSP as planned, but LUT 89,341 exceeds the cap

experiments.title: Weights in LUTRAM
experiments.idea: One change: weight storage from BRAM to LUTRAM
experiments.problem: First resource-feasible point; HLS timing warning

experiments.title: Fastest point of the sweep
experiments.idea: One axis per step: T, unroll split, weight storage, clock
experiments.problem: HLS timing warning; phase-1 selected point

experiments.title: First Vivado route
experiments.idea: Route the first feasible point at the 10 ns target
experiments.problem: WNS -1.277 ns: an unregistered 8-deep DSP cascade. First calibration point: clock 1.5x worse than HLS, LUT 0.46x

experiments.title: Packing PE: two 8-bit products per DSP
experiments.idea: 27-bit packed multiply, gap 18, signed-low borrow repair
experiments.metric_text: PE only: 1 DSP per pair, exact

experiments.title: Packing in the whole network
experiments.idea: Pair output channels so one DSP does two multiplications
experiments.problem: DSP halved, but decoding and selectors need 292,053 LUT

experiments.title: Winograd PE F(2x2,3x3)
experiments.idea: Exact integer transforms; inverse divides by 4 exactly

experiments.title: Winograd Conv1 in the network
experiments.idea: Nine 3x3 pieces of the 9x9 kernel, conditional tile scan
experiments.problem: 5.7 M Conv1 cycles: the conditional tile branch is taken at every position

experiments.title: Continuous Winograd
experiments.idea: Replace the conditional scan with a fixed-tile continuous pipeline
experiments.problem: T16 only; the T8 variant W09 needs 135,496 LUT

experiments.title: Winograd with narrow raw-weight bank
experiments.idea: Keep only the transformed banks the MAC engines read
experiments.problem: HLS timing warning; still slower than continuous direct convolution

experiments.title: Scatter with merged edge kernels
experiments.idea: Replace gather by channel-reduced scatter of partial sums
experiments.problem: Slower than the gather control G01 (29.8 ms); direction closed

experiments.title: Intermediate maps in DDR
experiments.idea: Expose the two scratch arrays through m_axi
experiments.problem: Global ports were not exported; tool still synthesized on-chip storage

experiments.title: Output-tile fusion B=8..64
experiments.idea: Fuse Conv1/Conv2 per output tile to shrink buffers
experiments.problem: Recomputed halos cost more cycles than the buffers save

experiments.title: Winograd + packing combined
experiments.idea: Stack the two DSP-saving routes
experiments.problem: LUT 248,797 / FF 307,525: far over the device; gains do not add

experiments.title: Continuous direct convolution
experiments.idea: Separate window generation from MAC engines; one II=1 pixel/fold loop
experiments.problem: 7,013 of 13,268 Conv3 LUT are multiplexers for the held window

experiments.title: Rotate the held window
experiments.idea: Rotate channels instead of dynamic selection
experiments.problem: Cycles unchanged; LUT/FF variants F14/F15 exceed budget

experiments.title: Exact IEEE output encoder
experiments.idea: Build the float output bit pattern directly: 0 DSP, 242 LUT

experiments.title: Encoder in the network, 3 ns target
experiments.idea: Replace only output decoding
experiments.problem: Global path 2.822 ns is the Conv1 weight loader's address multiplier

experiments.title: Affine weight-load indexing
experiments.idea: Remove the multiplier from the load address
experiments.problem: Critical path moves to a 2.699 ns flattened-loop counter

experiments.title: LOOP_FLATTEN off in the loader
experiments.idea: Only one directive changed
experiments.problem: HLS timing warning at 2.5 ns

experiments.title: Private parameter banks
experiments.idea: 46 % of F25 LUT sat outside the dataflow region in weight banks and muxes; one AXI reader streams parameters into per-layer private banks
experiments.problem: HLS estimate only; needs RTL and routing

experiments.title: Implement F25
experiments.idea: First place-and-route of the mainline
experiments.problem: Kernel OOM on the 15 GiB host: Vivado worker processes exceeded memory

experiments.title: RTL co-simulation of F25
experiments.idea: Two frames, finite FIFOs, deadlock detection

experiments.title: Implement F25, single-thread retry
experiments.idea: maxThreads=1 hook; routed at 5 ns, WNS +0.568

experiments.title: Implement F28
experiments.idea: Same flow on the private-bank design; routed at 5 ns

experiments.title: Route calibration (user decision)
experiments.idea: W21 HLS clock 2.43 ns vs 4.95 ns routed; routed LUT 0.46 to 0.66x HLS over 18 routes. Gates switch to post-route numbers (docs/0005)

experiments.title: Winograd T8 + streamed parameters
experiments.idea: Integrate the F28 parameter stream into the W18 Winograd design
experiments.problem: Narrowly misses the HLS LUT gate

experiments.title: Sub-kernel cache layout
experiments.idea: One change in the parameter transformer: cache indexed by sub-kernel
experiments.problem: Passes HLS gates narrowly; needs RTL and routing

experiments.title: RTL co-simulation of W21

experiments.title: Implement W21 at 4.5 ns
experiments.idea: Same RTL, Performance_Explore; WNS +0.144

experiments.title: Constant weights in ROM
experiments.idea: Fix the trained parameters at compile time; no AXI reader

experiments.title: Window FIFO 2 -> 16
experiments.idea: Only the transformed-window FIFO depth, after F97's stall evidence

experiments.title: Deep windows + FRP folds
experiments.idea: Combine F47's FIFO basis with W27's free-running pipelines

experiments.title: T4 with pre-packed Conv2
experiments.idea: Fold T=4; Conv2 uses E065's 8-bit weights packed two per DSP once per frame

experiments.title: Implement C13 at 5 ns
experiments.idea: RTL 300,632 cycles (C14); routed LUT 58,529, WNS +0.047; user asked for this route first

experiments.title: C13 + 32-entry window FIFO
experiments.idea: Only the FIFO depth, reusing F47's evidence at T4

experiments.title: Implement C17 at 5 ns
experiments.idea: RTL 273,023 cycles (C20); routed at 5.0 ns, WNS +0.013

experiments.title: Implement C17 at 4.5 ns

experiments.title: Registered parameter packet

experiments.title: System integration and board test
